name: nina_volkova
title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
job_desc:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Personalization - Lumen Commerce (Seattle / Remote)
Own the models that rank millions of products for 20M shoppers.
You will: design and ship retrieval and ranking models for recommendations and search; build training and serving pipelines (MLOps) with our feature store; run online A/B tests and read results rigorously; keep model serving fast and reliable on Kubernetes; explore LLM-based ranking and embeddings; mentor ML engineers.
Requirements: 5+ years building production ML; Python and PyTorch; recommendation or search ranking experience; Spark; AWS; experience serving models at low latency; strong experimentation skills.

interview.question: How do you decide a new model is ready to replace the one in production?
interview.answer: I train it and check the offline metrics like AUC. If it is better I run an A/B test and if that goes well we ship it.

facts: The recommendation model serves about 4 million product pages a day.
The 6.2% add-to-cart lift was worth about $3M in extra annual revenue according to the finance team.
Moving training to Kubeflow pipelines cut model retraining time from 2 days to 6 hours and made weekly retraining possible.
Nina led the ranker project end to end with one other engineer.
The churn model at Brightwave flagged at-risk subscribers well enough to cut monthly churn from 4.1% to 3.6% after a retention campaign used it.
Nina mentored two data scientists on moving notebooks to production code.
